text:
lara-partnerships: Quick sync — OrbitCloud just confirmed we can list in their new "orbit-1" satellite region. Need approvals for marketplace entitlements, quotas, KMS key region, and SI integration schedule. Targeting soft launch next Tue. Who's on point for each?

mike-ops: @lara-partnerships please share requested SKU/quotas. I can start quota ticket with cloud partner once we have numbers. also: who owns the marketplace listing assets (logos, legal copy)?

lara-partnerships: I'll attach assets. For quotas, early estimate: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs + 40 vCPUs for control plane, then scale to 32 GPUs in month 1 if traffic matches. That's provisional — sam-engineering, can you confirm capacity needs?

sam-engineering: we expect ~120 QPS peak for initial customers, avg seq len ~256. Prob need 10x 80GB GPUs for serving (pref quantized), plus 4 control-plane VMs (8 vCPU). If OrbitCloud limits GPU SKU variety, we can fall back to their Turing family but perf will vary.

anya-legal: NDA with OrbitCloud signed (I cc'ed legal contact). Marketplace terms: they require a Data Processing Addendum and a brief security questionnaire. I can draft the DPA addendum. Do we have the security answers documented?

jess-sales: heads up — channel sales wants joint announcement but legal/regulatory sign-off is blocking. prefer to avoid public announcement until quotas + DPA are in place. Can we aim for a private partner blog first? :eyes:

kevin-kms: KMS update — OrbitCloud supports Bring-Your-Own-Key via their KMS gateway, BUT HSM-backed keys in orbit-1 are on a delayed schedule (ETA ~3 weeks). We can provision software keys now; if customer needs HSM we need to coordinate a migration. If you want me to request tenant keyspace now I can open the ticket.

terry-cloud-sys: For quota ticket, use this JSON snippet in OrbitCloud partner portal: ```json
{
  "project": "redwood-orbit-1-onboard",
  "quotas": [
    {"sku": "orbit.gpu.a100x80", "limit": 8},
    {"sku": "orbit.vcpu.standard", "limit": 40}
  ],
  "requested_by": "mike-ops",
  "eta": "2026-04-05"
}
```  paste into partner UI -> submit. I'll triage once it's created.

deploy-bot: Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/regions/orbit-1-onboard (read-only). Automated smoke deploy scheduled: `deploy --region orbit-1 --smoke` — will run after quotas are approved.

mike-ops: I will open the quota ticket today (putting ETA = 4/5). @kevin-kms please open KMS tenant request. @anya-legal please start DPA addendum; we can attach to marketplace listing.

lara-partnerships: timeline check — if quota approved by 4/5 and DPA done by 4/7, we can do an internal soft launch 4/9 and public partner notice 4/14. Does that work for sales/marketing?

jess-sales: internal soft launch is fine, public announcement needs PR sign-off. I'll loop in marketing once legal confirms DPA.

sam-engineering: one more note — we need a rollback plan if OrbitCloud GPU perf degrades. Suggest we keep a fallback routing policy to eu-west1/dedicated pools for critical customers. I'll add a canary in the rollout.

kevin-kms: KMS ticket opened: ORBIT-KMS-4321. Requested software keys now, HSM migration scheduled tentatively for 2026-04-25.

anya-legal: Draft DPA addendum in progress, sending initial version in ~4 hours for review.

terry-cloud-sys: quota ticket submitted: QC-9876 on OrbitCloud partner portal. They requested region usage justification — I added the `120 QPS` + model sizes.

lara-partnerships: awesome. Action items: 1) mike-ops monitor QC-9876, push for expedited review. 2) kevin-kms confirm key provisioning and share key ARN. 3) anya-legal finish DPA. 4) sam-engineering prepare canary route and fallback. 5) jess-sales hold public comms until PR sign-off. I'll update this thread with finalized launch date. :thumbsup:

mike-ops: noted — ping me if we need to escalate to partner PM.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: smoke deploy job queued for 2026-04-09T02:00:00Z pending quota + KMS.

lara-partnerships: thanks everyone — tagging partners: @OrbitCloud-PM and @StrataSI in the partner channel to confirm integration test windows. Will sync again after DPA posted.

jess-sales: thanks, good plan.

sam-engineering: I'll drop the canary playbook in the runbook doc in 30m.

kevin-kms: shared key ARN to #secure-keys channel (private).

anya-legal: DPA draft posted: https://runs.docs/redwood/dpa-orbitcloud-draft — please review.

lara-partnerships: thread complete for now — will reopen if any blocker pops up.
